slots.notes: Looping preview clip filling each story card's media well in the horizontal scroll-snap rail (.story-card__media <video autoplay muted loop playsinline>, object-fit cover / object-position center at a fixed 16/9 aspect-ratio, 12px border-radius, sitting on a #dfe5e6 placeholder bg with a 0 18px 48px rgb(21 34 34 / .1) shadow). Five card sockets rendered in order, each paired with its own category-tag / title / meta copy; the spec reuses card 1's clip for card 4 and card 2's clip for card 5, so only 3 distinct source clips are needed to fill all 5 sockets. Muted autoplaying loops, so supply short seamless loops with no audio dependency.

mechanic: A light #f7f8f8 section with a centered heading over a CSS-grid horizontal rail (grid-auto-flow column, scroll-snap-type x mandatory, content-aligned edge-bleed gutters) of 16:9 looping-video story cards that sit dimmed (opacity .54, translateY 10px) and rise to full opacity on hover/focus, trailed by a static segmented progress-bar footer.
techDelivery: Hand-authored semantic HTML5 section + plain CSS spec (BEM-style .video-stories classes, clamp() fluid type/spacing, one --hero-max-width custom property, native CSS scroll-snap, and 860px / 560px media-query breakpoints); no JS framework or build step implied.
reskinNotes: The palette is a monochrome neutral set with no accent token: dark text #111111 and #252b2b plus four muted greys (#697272, #858d8d, #7a8282 and divider #cfd4d4) and the #dfe5e6 media-well bg are all written as literal hex inside individual CSS rules, and color is NOT exposed as custom properties (only --hero-max-width: 1820px is a variable), so each tone must be retinted by hand. The 'active' progress bar is just fg #111111, so a brand accent has to be introduced deliberately. Layout is font-metric- and copy-length dependent: clamp() heading/body/padding sizes are tuned to Geist metrics, the rail's first/last-card alignment relies on the calc((100vw - var(--hero-max-width)) / 2 + 48px) gutter math against grid-auto-columns minmax(520px,34vw) (320px,82vw under 860px), and the footer is hardcoded to 5 cards (three segment bars, the third 320px 'active' bar shrinking to 150px at 560px, and a literal '05 / 05' counter). All seed copy (H2, intro paragraph, the five category/title/meta strings, the '05 / 05' label, and the 'EngineTech video previews' rail aria-label) is embedded in markup and must be replaced per brand.
